ProblemText:
What is the sum of the angles in a triangle?
A) 90 degrees
B) 180 degrees
C) 270 degrees
D) 360 degrees

A triangle has angles measuring $30^{\circ}$ and $60^{\circ}$. What is the measure of the third angle?
A) $30^{\circ}$
B) $60^{\circ}$
C) $90^{\circ}$
D) $120^{\circ}$

A rectangle has a length of 8 cm and a width of 5 cm. What is its area?
A) 20 cm²
B) 30 cm²
C) 40 cm²
D) 50 cm²

A parallelogram has a base of 10 m and a height of 4 m. What is its area?
A) 20 m²
B) 30 m²
C) 40 m²
D) 50 m²

A trapezoid has bases of lengths 6 m and 10 m, and a height of 5 m. What is its area?
A) 30 m²
B) 40 m²
C) 50 m²
D) 60 m²

A right rectangular prism has a length of 4 cm, a width of 3 cm, and a height of 5 cm. What is its volume?
A) 60 cm³
B) 50 cm³
C) 40 cm³
D) 30 cm³

If the area of a triangle is given by the formula $A = \frac{1}{2} \times base \times height$, what is the area of a triangle with a base of 12 cm and a height of 5 cm?
A) 30 cm²
B) 40 cm²
C) 60 cm²
D) 70 cm²

A triangle has sides measuring 7 cm, 10 cm, and 5 cm. Can these lengths form a triangle?
A) Yes
B) No
C) Only if one side is longer
D) Only if two sides are equal

Convert 1500 milliliters to liters.
A) 0.15 L
B) 1.5 L
C) 15 L
D) 150 L

A rectangular garden is 10 m long and 6 m wide. If you want to increase the width by 2 m, what will be the new area of the garden?
A) 60 m²
B) 80 m²
C) 100 m²
D) 120 m²
